I've implemented the plugin-based custom response body decoder system. Here's a summary of the changes:

## New files

**`packages/api-client/src/v2/blocks/response-block/helpers/resolve-response-content-type.ts`**
- `DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CONTENT_TYPE = 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'`
- `resolveResponseContentType(ct)` — returns the string unchanged, or the default for `null`/`undefined` (via `??`, so empty-string is preserved).
- `resolveResponseMimeType(ct)` — parses to a MIME object; essence is `'text/plain'` when input is `null`/`undefined`.

**`packages/api-client/src/v2/blocks/response-block/helpers/resolve-response-body-handler.ts`**
- `resolveResponseBodyHandler(mimeType, plugins)` — returns the first matching `ResponseBodyHandler`, skipping plugins with no `responseBody`. Matching is case-insensitive with `*` wildcards (`application/vnd.*+json` matches `application/vnd.api+json`), and a handler may declare multiple MIME types.

## Modified files

**`packages/oas-utils/src/helpers/client-plugins.ts`** (+ `index.ts`) — added and exported the `ResponseBodyHandler` type (`mimeTypes`, optional `decode(buf, contentType?)`, optional `language`) and added optional `responseBody` to `ClientPlugin`. Rebuilt oas-utils dist so the type resolves.

**`decode-buffer.ts`** — now `async`, accepts optional `pluginHandler`. When the handler has a `decode` function it delegates (passing buffer + full content type, awaiting to support sync/async returns); otherwise it falls back to default text/binary decoding.

**`send-request.ts`** — the argument object now includes required `plugins: ClientPlugin[]`. In the standard-response path it resolves the content type (defaulting to `text/plain;charset=UTF-8` when absent), looks up a plugin handler by MIME essence, and awaits `decodeBuffer` with the resolved content type.

**`process-response-body.ts`** — `mimeType` now defaults to `text/plain` (essence) when no content-type header is present.

**Call sites** — `OperationBlock.vue` passes its `plugins` prop; `use-runner-execution.ts` and the playground pass `plugins: []`.

- New helpers, async `decodeBuffer`, wildcard/case-insensitive matching, and an end-to-end `sendRequest` flow (plugin decoding a no-content-type response and receiving `'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'`) all pass via ad-hoc tests.

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { resolveResponseBodyHandler } from '@/v2/blocks/response-block/helpers/resolve-response-body-handler'
+import { DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CONTENT_TYPE, resolveResponseContentType, resolveResponseMimeType } from '@/v2/blocks/response-block/helpers/resolve-response-content-type'
+import { decodeBuffer } from '@/v2/blocks/operation-block/helpers/decode-buffer'
+
+describe('sanity', () => {

+    expect(DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CONTENT_TYPE).toBe('text/plain;charset=UTF-8')
+  })
+  it('resolveResponseContentType', () => {
+    expect(resolveResponseContentType('application/json')).toBe('application/json')
+    expect(resolveResponseContentType(null)).toBe('text/plain;charset=UTF-8')
+    expect(resolveResponseContentType(undefined)).toBe('text/plain;charset=UTF-8')
+  })
+  it('resolveResponseMimeType', () => {
+    expect(resolveResponseMimeType(null).essence).toBe('text/plain')
+    expect(resolveResponseMimeType(undefined).essence).toBe('text/plain')
+    expect(resolveResponseMimeType('application/json').essence).toBe('application/json')
+  })
+  it('wildcard + case-insensitive matching', () => {
+    const plugins = [
+      { hooks: {} },
+      { responseBody: [{ mimeTypes: ['application/vnd.*+json'], decode: () => 'x' }] },
+    ]
+    expect(resolveResponseBodyHandler('application/vnd.api+json', plugins)).toBeDefined()
+    expect(resolveResponseBodyHandler('APPLICATION/VND.API+JSON', plugins)).toBeDefined()
+    expect(resolveResponseBodyHandler('text/plain', plugins)).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(resolveResponseBodyHandler('x/y', [])).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+  it('multiple mimeTypes per handler', () => {
+    const plugins = [{ responseBody: [{ mimeTypes: ['text/a', 'text/b'] }] }]

+  })
+  it('decodeBuffer async + plugin decode with contentType', async () => {

+    expect(await decodeBuffer(buf, 'x', asyncHandler)).toBe('async-result')
+  })
